adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates over it to create events for multiple destination calendars. However, `handleNewBooking.ts` persists only the first destination calendar on the Booking (`connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` around ~1843-1871). Later “deferred” flows rebuild `CalendarEvent` from the stored booking row, which only contains a single `booking.destinationCalendar`, and wrap it as a one-element array (e.g., `confirm.handler.ts`, `paypal-webhook.ts`, `payments/api/webhook.ts`, `editLocation.handler.ts`, `deleteCredential.handler.ts`, `requestReschedule.handler.ts`). As a result, when confirmation/payment triggers creation later, `EventManager` only sees one destination calendar and will only create one calendar event, so additional collective hosts’ destination calendars won’t get events.
